Zendesk (ZEN) Stake Increased by Pier Capital Llc; Private Asset Management Holds Holding in Duke Energy (DUK)
July 15, 2018 - By Nell Hawkins
Pier Capital Llc increased its stake in Zendesk Inc (ZEN) by 10.16% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Pier Capital Llc bought 16,405 shares as the company’s stock rose 30.39% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 177,915 shares of the technology company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $8.52M, up from 161,510 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Pier Capital Llc who had been investing in Zendesk Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $6.24 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.18% or $0.11 during the last trading session, reaching $59.68. About 1.13M shares traded. Zendesk, Inc. (NYSE:ZEN) has risen 119.18% since July 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 106.61% the S&P500. Private Asset Management Inc increased its stake in Duke Energy Corp (DUK) by 22.34% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Private Asset Management Inc bought 5,889 shares as the company’s stock declined 2.71% with the market. The institutional investor held 32,249 shares of the power generation company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $2.50M, up from 26,360 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Private Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Duke Energy Corp for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $56.52 billion market cap company. The stock increased 0.15% or $0.12 during the last trading session, reaching $80.62. About 3.37 million shares traded. Duke Energy Corporation (NYSE:DUK) has declined 10.96% since July 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 23.53% the S&P500. The company was maintained on Wednesday, February 7 by Guggenheim. Piper Jaffray initiated Zendesk, Inc. (NYSE:ZEN) rating on Wednesday, June 1. Piper Jaffray has “Overweight” rating and $35 target. The firm has “Hold” rating by Stifel Nicolaus given on Friday, July 21.
Pier Capital Llc, which manages about $585.14M US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in Faro Technologies Inc (NASDAQ:FARO) by 5,350 shares to 103,514 shares, valued at $6.05 million in 2018Q1, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Kadant Inc (NYSE:KAI) by 29,200 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 30,169 shares, and cut its stake in Wns Holdings Ltd (NYSE:WNS).
